items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember that date. That was at Rudy Van Gelder’s. I think Herbie invited me to play.

ctx.x: I didn’t mean to cut you off. You mentioned Chick, McCoy, . . .

. . . and Herbie. That’s going to get us into the ’60s or maybe the late ’50s. Let’s go back to when you get your – prior to you receiving your scholarship to Juilliard, and what led up to that. What are you doing here in L.A.? You had these two major gigs. What is it? The Tail Spin, wherever. How long were you in L.A. before you started your path towards Juilliard?
